plays.description: Pass short middle to Odunze for 21 yards (D.Belton); challenged and upheld as down by contact at CHI 47
Pass deep middle to Burden for 20 yards to NYJ 33 (M.Fitzpatrick)
Pass deep right to Burden for 22 yards, ruled down at NYJ 33 (B.Stephens)
Rushing touchdown, right guard for 1 yard; extra point good
Interception return by Fitzpatrick for 27 yards to CHI 34 (S.Roush)
Pass to Odunze for first down at the 40 yard line
Field goal good from 30 yards; Bears lead 10-3
Pass deep middle to Odunze for 37 yards to NYJ 16 (M.Fitzpatrick)
Field goal good from 30 yards; Bears lead 13-3
Pass caught by Odunze for 20 yards, pushed out at CHI 24 (B.Stephens)
Fumble on run; recovered by B.Stephens at CHI 28
Crossing pattern to Isaiah Williams inside the 15
Pass to Kmet (Loveland?) caught for first and goal at the 8
Rushing touchdown for Monangai, his second of the day; extra point good
Pass to Luther Burden for first down
Run by Monangai for 26 yards to NYJ 18 (D.Belton; M.Fitzpatrick)
Field goal good from 21 yards; Bears lead 23-6
Passing touchdown to Isaiah Williams for 58 yards; extra point no good

offense_strengths: Big play ability in the passing game with a 58-yard touchdown pass to I.Williams
defense_weaknesses: Poor run defense allowing multiple big runs and two rushing touchdowns by K.Monangai
Struggled in coverage allowing multiple deep passes and big gains to R.Odunze and L.Burden
Failed to generate pressure consistently leading to 0/7 on third downs in one stretch
Vulnerable to play-action and deep middle passes

offense_strengths: Strong running game with K.Monangai and D.Swift gaining big yards and scoring two rushing TDs
Effective deep and intermediate passing game with accurate throws from T.Bagent to R.Odunze, L.Burden, and C.Loveland
Capitalized on turnovers and short fields to score frequently
Good red zone efficiency converting to multiple TDs and FGs
defense_weaknesses: Allowed a 58-yard passing touchdown to I.Williams on a coverage breakdown involving T.Stevenson and D.Thieneman
Gave up several chunk plays in the passing game despite overall good performance

limitations: Could not determine specific concepts like run gaps, play-action, screens, RPOs, personnel formations (except one mention of 13 personnel), or coverage schemes because the captions rarely explicitly stated them. Many plays in captions were vague on exact yardage or did not perfectly align with DB entries so used 'NO DB MATCH' or approximate matches. Auto-generated captions mangled several names which were corrected only for clear matches to DB. Could not identify every single play mentioned in DB due to caption limitations and lack of video.
